evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'it might take around ten to fifteen minutes' and customer agrees, but no explicit promise-of-dependable-quote framing or real wait for affirmation before pivoting to address details.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name confirmed (Claudia), moving day (Friday October 2nd mentioned), city (San Antonio to San Antonio), size (one bedroom apartment) — all four present.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into probing: 'are we also going to be moving items from your balcony from your garage storage unit' without first asking about customer's concerns or what answers they want.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor (4th to 14th), rooms (1 bedroom), walking distances (3-minute walk from truck to elevator pickup, 30-second walk within apartment, ~10 feet truck to loading dock to elevator, ~30 feet elevator to unit), elevator type (public vs. reserved), additional items (furniture list clarified: nightstands, bed frame, mattress, couch, coffee table, TV stand, lamp, bar stools, dust chair).
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'How many total number of boxes are we going to move for you ma'am?' Customer answered 'probably none maybe like one or two.'
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: No — never asked if customer wants packing services.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full: Rep provides typical range for one-bedroom (2.5–3.5 hours), personalizes to this customer's specifics (4th to 14th floor, walking distances, elevator timing), and gives price: '$618 to $824.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full: Hourly rate ($206/hr), comprehensive inclusions (gas, truck, insurance, wraps, pads, tools), explicit no-hidden-fee list (no transportation, credit card, stereo, disassemble fees), minimum ($515 for 2.5 hours), 15-minute increments ($51.50), no deposit mentioned, and damage coverage/on-time guarantee stated.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never asks 'does that feel fair?' Instead, customer volunteers a question ('What I want, I, what was the total amount that I was quoted?') and rep repeats the estimate.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'We also have an on time guarantee. So, if the movers arrive late, you start to get discount on your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: 'You're also gonna get a evaluation coverage. So, if anything gets damaged, anything gets broken or gets miss handled during the move, you can file a claim for zero deductible or no deductible. We either gonna repair, replace or reimburse that.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No — rep does not ask 'does that put those to rest?' or similar after the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep never asks 'what's still concerning you?' or any genuine final-concerns check. Call ends with customer's price confirmation.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No — rep does not ask 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full: 'So would you want our help with the move?' — asked plainly, no softened out offered.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes: 'We do not require any deposit' (implicitly confirms the quote holds).
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Date confirmed (Friday October 2nd), arrival window confirmed (8:30–9:00 AM), addresses and unit numbers confirmed (4407 at origin, 1424 at destination). Phone number and crew size (2 movers) not explicitly re-confirmed. No notes left for crew about customer's concerns (none were raised, so no concern to document).

top_strength: Arden gathered comprehensive logistics details with precision—walking distances, floor numbers, elevator types, furniture inventory—enabling a personalized and well-supported estimate, and delivered the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full clarity and credibility.
coaching_note: Section 2 must happen early: ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' before diving into probing, and Section 6 must close the call: ask 'What's still concerning you?' after the Two Promises, before the explicit ask—both are currently skipped, leaving discovery incomplete and permission unconfirmed.
